stepAnswer: cos(A - B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B
stepTitle: Step 1: Identify the Compound Angle Pattern
stepBody: The expression cos A cos B + sin A sin B matches which compound angle formula?
choices: cos(A - B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B
cos(A + B) = cos A cos B - sin A sin B
sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B
sin(A - B) = sin A cos B - cos A sin B
